rejected_inference: No observed corruption under high-rate disposable stress does NOT imply the SQLite WAL-reset race is absent or that Frank release safety is proven.
reason: SQLite's own primary documentation says the race has very tight timing constraints and required special deliberate test logic to reproduce for validation.
architecture_consequence: Retain fail-closed version/patch/topology evidence gate. Do not spend repeated compute attempting to Goodhart a rare-race absence statistic into a safety claim.
future_reuse: Use this result as evidence that ordinary stress frequency is a poor promotion metric for this bug class and that causal precondition/provenance tests dominate repeated null stress trials.
